evidence: Reproducibility: python3 analysis/make_claims.py --no-run gave 424 claims and no diff in results/claims.json or paper/results.tex. I also re-ran stratify, analyze, analyze_a4, analyze_a5, analyze_h3, analyze_sensitivity and analyze_sonnet in a clean git-archive copy; every results*.json was byte-identical, and so was claims.json regenerated from them.

Independent recomputation from exps/c3/raw with my own parser (scratchpad rc.py) matched the paper: UNSOLVED PICK 0.60, ISO-any 0.356, d +0.244 (n=90); SOLVED 0.117 / 0.058 (n=137); h2u +0.194 and h2s +0.018; gate wrong-accept 0.0778 and right-accept 0.827 (681 and 214 verdicts); strata 137/90/50/1 of 278; A4 PICK hit 0.62, fa 0.59, J +0.026; EACH 0.57 / 0.45; ISO hit 0.44 / fa 0.32; dJ -0.09, dhit +0.18; A5 fa_base 0.603 vs fa_pick 0.590; H3 same-minus-cross +0.016 (n=225); raw call counts per arm and models (claude-haiku-5-5 / claude-sonnet-5-5 on every record).

Also matched to sources: c3_n_dup=5, disagreements=22, audit 14 solved + 6 mixed, label audit 4+2 problems, 13 competitions (7 arXiv-derived), 80 ledger rows, subject cost 283.48, gemma d=0 and iso-wrong 0.80, C2 sonnet parse 0.896 with 10 tool-imitation failures, sonnet safeguard blocks (2 ISO and 1 EACH in C3, 1 PICK in C2, exps/c3/run_*_s.log), 24 C2 contest problems, 60 screen problems with 180 distinct wrong candidates. More than 30 claim ids were checked.
